note: Plan 188: semantic colour restructure (Option P, muted/emphasis, states to the component layer).

descriptions.color.background.default: Page background. The default, muted and faint foreground tokens are readable on it.
descriptions.color.background.muted: Quiet surface for sections, panels and containers. The default, muted and faint foreground tokens are readable on it.
descriptions.color.background.emphasis: Stronger surface for nested or emphasized areas, one step more contrast than muted. The default and muted foreground tokens are readable on it.
descriptions.color.background.raised: Surface of a component that floats above the page (card, popover, dropdown, dialog, sheet, toast). The same as the page in Light, one step lighter in Dark.
descriptions.color.background.overlay: Scrim colour behind a modal or sheet; applied at opacity.scrim, never opaque.
descriptions.color.background.inverse: Surface that is dark in Light mode and light in Dark mode (tooltips, inverted blocks). Pairs with foreground.inverse.
descriptions.color.foreground.default: Default text and icon colour for headings and body content. Readable on the page, muted, emphasis and raised backgrounds.
descriptions.color.foreground.muted: Quieter text for descriptions and captions. Readable on the page, muted, emphasis and raised backgrounds.
descriptions.color.foreground.faint: Faintest text for timestamps, metadata and hints. Readable on the page, muted and raised backgrounds.
descriptions.color.border.default: Default border for cards, inputs and containers.
descriptions.color.border.emphasis: Stronger border for control boundaries that need 3:1 against the page (inputs, checkboxes, switches).
descriptions.color.border.focus: Keyboard focus ring colour. Centralized: every component's focus indicator uses it.
descriptions.color.background.info-muted: Quiet informational tint for alerts and highlights. Pairs with foreground.info-muted.
descriptions.color.foreground.info-muted: Informational text on its tint (background.info-muted) and on the page.
descriptions.color.background.primary: Solid fill for the main action colour. Pairs with foreground.primary.
descriptions.color.background.primary-muted: Quiet tint of the primary role for alerts, badges and highlights. Pairs with foreground.primary-muted.
descriptions.color.background.primary-emphasis: Stronger tone of the solid primary fill. Components use it for hover and pressed states; foreground.primary is readable on it.
descriptions.color.foreground.primary: Text and icons on the solid primary fill. Pairs with background.primary and background.primary-emphasis.
descriptions.color.foreground.primary-muted: Primary text on its tint (background.primary-muted) and on the page.
descriptions.color.border.primary: Accent border in the primary colour (cards, highlights, rings); non-text, so it needs 3:1 on the page.
descriptions.color.background.danger: Solid fill for destructive actions and errors. Pairs with foreground.danger.
descriptions.color.background.danger-muted: Quiet tint of the danger role for alerts, badges and highlights. Pairs with foreground.danger-muted.
descriptions.color.background.danger-emphasis: Stronger tone of the solid danger fill. Components use it for hover and pressed states; foreground.danger is readable on it.
descriptions.color.foreground.danger: Text and icons on the solid danger fill. Pairs with background.danger and background.danger-emphasis.
descriptions.color.foreground.danger-muted: Danger text on its tint (background.danger-muted) and on the page.
descriptions.color.border.danger: Border in the danger colour for alerts, toasts and highlights.
descriptions.color.background.success: Solid fill for positive confirmation. Pairs with foreground.success.
descriptions.color.background.success-muted: Quiet tint of the success role for alerts, badges and highlights. Pairs with foreground.success-muted.
descriptions.color.background.success-emphasis: Stronger tone of the solid success fill. Components use it for hover and pressed states; foreground.success is readable on it.
descriptions.color.foreground.success: Text and icons on the solid success fill. Pairs with background.success and background.success-emphasis.
descriptions.color.foreground.success-muted: Success text on its tint (background.success-muted) and on the page.
descriptions.color.border.success: Border in the success colour for alerts, toasts and highlights.
descriptions.color.background.warning: Solid fill for caution. Pairs with foreground.warning.
descriptions.color.background.warning-muted: Quiet tint of the warning role for alerts, badges and highlights. Pairs with foreground.warning-muted.
descriptions.color.background.warning-emphasis: Stronger tone of the solid warning fill. Components use it for hover and pressed states; foreground.warning is readable on it.
descriptions.color.foreground.warning: Dark text and icons on the solid warning fill (an amber fill cannot hold light text). Pairs with background.warning and background.warning-emphasis.
descriptions.color.foreground.warning-muted: Warning text on its tint (background.warning-muted) and on the page.
descriptions.color.border.warning: Border in the warning colour for alerts, toasts and highlights.
